captions.caption: A man with long hair and a beard sits by a campfire near a lake, holding a small object.
The man examines the small object while sitting on a fur rug near the fire.
The man raises the object towards his face, possibly smelling or inspecting it closely.
The man continues to inspect the object in his hands, with a wooden shelter in the background.
The man manipulates the small object with his fingers while sitting by the campfire.
The man looks down at the object, with the lake and mountains visible in the distance.
The man uses his fingers to work on the small object, seated on a fur rug.
The man continues working on the object, with smoke from the campfire rising nearby.
The man holds the object and looks at it intently while sitting outdoors.
The man touches his face while holding the object, with the fire burning in the foreground.
The man lowers his hand and continues to sit by the campfire at dusk.
The man places the object down and prepares to move from his seated position.
The man starts to stand up or shift his position on the fur rug.
A close-up shot shows moss and lichen growing on a rock surface.
Hands reach into the frame to pick something from the low-growing vegetation.
The hands carefully pluck small berries or plants from the rocky ground.
The person's hands continue to forage among the green moss and plants.
More small plants are gathered by the person's hands on the rock.
The person picks another small plant or berry from the lichen-covered rock.
The person's hands move out of the frame after gathering the items.
The camera remains focused on the green plants growing on the gray rock.
The person stands up and walks away in the blurred background.
The person continues walking through the forest, seen as a blurred figure.
The camera stays on the mossy rock while the person moves further away.
The shot transitions to the man squatting in a field of low bushes.
The man reaches into the bushes to pick small dark berries.
The man carefully selects and plucks berries from the shrubs.
The man's hands move through the green leaves as he continues to forage.
The man picks more berries and holds them in his hand.
The man examines a handful of small dark berries he just picked.
The man looks at the berries in his palm while squatting in the field.
The man uses his finger to count or sort the berries in his hand.
A close-up shows several small, dark, round berries on the man's dirty palm.
The man's finger points to one of the berries on his hand.
The man continues to display the berries, moving his finger over them.
The close-up reveals the texture and color of the dark berries in the man's hand.
The man shifts the berries slightly on his palm for better viewing.
The man's finger touches another berry in his hand.
The camera remains focused on the berries as the man's hand moves slightly.
The man continues to show the berries on his hand to the camera.
The man's finger moves across the small dark berries on his palm.
The berries are held steady in the center of the frame.
The man's finger points to a specific berry among the group.
The man continues to inspect the berries on his hand.
The camera captures a detailed view of the berries and the man's weathered hand.
The man moves his finger away from the berries in his palm.
The man stands on a rock at the edge of a calm lake at dusk.
The man bends down and cups his hands to scoop water from the lake.
The man drinks the water he scooped from the lake with his hands.
The man reaches down again to scoop more water from the lake's surface.
The man brings his cupped hands to his mouth to drink more water.
The man leans over the water, with the forest and sky reflected in the lake.
The man scoops water for the third time while standing on the rocky shore.
The man drinks the fresh water from the lake.
The man reaches down once more to gather water in his hands.
The man takes another drink of water from the lake.
The man continues to scoop water while squatting on the rock.
The man drinks from his hands, with the calm lake water rippling slightly.
The man reaches down for one final scoop of water.
The man drinks the water and prepares to stand up from the rock.
